{{Quote|Something Nuso Esva will already have thought of. Odds are that private hangar of his is within easy striking distance of the spaceport.|Unidentified Rebel captain on Nuso Esva|<ref name="COO" />}}
This '''captain''' served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and was part of the Rebel force sent to the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] during a [[Battle for Poln Major|mission]]<ref name="COO" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> When [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]'s [[Eastern Fleet]] arrived in the system, the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] warned [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] that evacuating the Rebels' [[Starship/Legends|ships]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]] woud be difficult, given that Esva's private hangar and its [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were within striking distance of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="COO" />
